notes.title: Update to SpaceWorms 1.5.3j
notes.content:
Humble wormlings,

1.5.3j has been uploaded to your mighty wormputers!

Drums are rolling, clarions are horny, the following changes have been enforced:

Fixes:
- Crashes when textures of players couldn't be loaded
- Overwriting of profiles after updates
- Erroneous loading of cursor
- Challenge 14 has been fixed: Special thanks to "Faraworm"

Personal victories:
- It is running on Win 8.1
- Texture preloading in order to boost game performance

Worm long and prosper,

Wormfred II

notes.title: Update to SpaceWorms 1.5.2
notes.content:
Feareth not, beloved mobocracy, for Ze Wormperor hast just released a new updateth.  Henceforth, thee shalt enjoyeth

[list]
[*] nay more crashes whence thy nameth enwheels special charact'rs,
[*] nay more ado completing dare 9 beyond thy owneth incompetence,
[*] to playeth ze game only whilst Steam is running,
[*] a correct displayeth of did save options,
[*] correct behavior at which hour collecting upgrades for thy planet thee already possesseth,
[*] an improved error logging to findeth zem bugs in HIS messy code, and
[*] fullscreen options for not only one but up to two screens. 
 [/list]

Liveth longeth and wiggle,
- Ze Worminator

notes.title: Update to SpaceWorms 1.5.0
notes.content:
We just updated SpaceWorms, including the following changes:

[list]
[*] Greatly optimized network gaming performance.
[*] Reduced initial loading time.
[*] Adjusted mouse controls for smoother gameplay.
[*] Migrated from OpenGL to DirectX, from x86 to x64, and to the .Net Framework 4.6.1.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]

Live long and wiggle
- Ze Wormperor

notes.title: Small release day update
notes.content:
Hi there,

To be on par with the big studios, we just patched SpaceWorms:

- Improved mouse controls.
- Fixed some minor bugs.
- Added control scheme image for a better overview.
- Added online player counter.

Enjoy
- Ze Wormperor
